answer: The cheapest real defence: pay rewards over a slow vesting curve tied to continued correct work, because umber only stays cheap while a farm must fund and babysit every clone for weeks before cashing anything out. Any river approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
